about.headline: Meet Renu
about.story: For Renu, yoga is a sanctuary and ultimately a journey of coming home to yourself. Born and raised in India, Renu has been teaching yoga in the UK since 2009. Her early inspiration came from her primary school principal, who continued practising yoga well into his eighties, demonstrating the lifelong benefits of movement, discipline, and self-care. She draws inspiration from her family, particularly her father, a civil servant with a deep interest in homeopathy, natural healing, and holistic wellbeing, as well as her sister, a highly respected Ayurvedic doctor, and her brother-in-law, a renowned physician. Alongside her yoga journey, Renu has worked in the corporate sector for many years, giving her a deep understanding of the pressures and challenges of modern life. This unique combination of corporate experience and yogic wisdom allows her to offer practical tools that support both personal and professional wellbeing.
about.philosophy: Renu holds a master's degree in yoga therapy and specialises in Prenatal Yoga. She has trained with respected teachers in the UK and continues to deepen her knowledge through ongoing study and practice. She has a special interest in the mystical dimensions of yoga, including Yoga Nidra, Meditation, Mantra, yogic philosophy, and the lives and teachings of great yogic masters and mystics. A lifelong student of yoga, Renu believes yoga is far more than physical exercise—it is a practical system for cultivating physical health, mental wellbeing, resilience, self-awareness, and a deeper connection with life. Through Strings of Yoga, her mission is to create a welcoming and supportive space where people can reconnect with themselves and discover practices that nurture health, balance, and inner wellbeing.
